# Additive v2 independent receipts, 2026-10-15
Previous complete v1 review and receipts remain immutable. All v2 before/after spans read and exact sequential replay checked against the matching v1 staged entry. Every previous independent correction reapplied, except two overlapping Kafka edits for which the author's equivalent stable-routing/retry/serial-effect and split-key ordering caveats are retained explicitly in reconciliation.json. - https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/index-condition-pushdown-optimization.html reopened. Official ICP access methods are range/ref/eq_ref/ref_or_null, and InnoDB secondary indexes when full row access is needed. A plain index scan does not qualify. All original unique conditions remain through v1 retention proof plus v2 composed span map, including twelfth-page post and quoted salary/experience labels.
